description: Interp live source for the BeatSaberRL policy (python/evolinterp): publishes interp.* (residual stream, attention, probes, logit lens, SAE features) for the selected sample and follows interp.ctl.* (layer, token, sample, play, ablate). First start captures activations (~15 s) and trains probes in the background (~1-2 min); later starts load data/interp caches. Stop interp-toy first (same prefix).
